{{Classes used for Sailing at the Summer Olympics|year = 2004}}

The '''Mixed [[Tornado (sailboat)|Tornado]]''' was a sailing event on the [[Sailing at the 2004 Summer Olympics]] program in [[Agios Kosmas Olympic Sailing Centre]].<ref name="A" /> Eleven races were scheduled and completed with one discard. 35 sailors, on 17 boats, from 17 nation competed.<ref name="Scoring_System" /><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.olympedia.org/results/11138 |title=Sailing at the 2004 Summer Olympics: Multihull (Tornado), Open |work=Olympedia |access-date=29 June 2020}}</ref>
